cause: The live planar mirror refreshed at about 5 Hz and only 10 Hz during camera changes, independently of the main view. Its simulation-time interval could slow further under low frame rates.
fix: Both WebGL and WebGPU refresh the mirror from the same animation/camera pose on every presented frame. WebGL updates the shared shadow atlas before either view uses it. Hidden/offscreen pausing and the one-frame GPU budget remain in force.
preserved: 1024 x 1024 HDR reflection, clipping/frustum coverage, transmission snapshots, original materials and lighting, full map resolution and effects.
